ORDER This is (repeat) third application filed on behalf of applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail relating to Crime No.41 of 2020 registered by Police Station - Anuppur, District- Anuppur (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC and also under Section 6(1) of Madhya Pradesh Nikshepako Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000.

entities.text: Madhya Pradesh Nikshepako Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in custody since 03.12.2022.

His second bail application was dismissed as withdrawn on 22.04.2025.
2 .
Prosecution story in brief is that applicant and co-accused, directors and managers of Aadhar Multiple Producer Ltd., collected Rs. 6.94 crore from the public by promising high returns.
However, they failed to repay the deposits, closed the company office, and absconded, thereby cheating the investors.
The applicant, as a director, was involved in the collection of these NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:627 2 MCRC-35955-2025 funds.
The final report indicates that the amount involved in this crime is Rs. 2.5 crores.
3 . Learned counsel for applicant has submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.
Applicant is a lady and has been in custody for more than three years.
Prosecution witnesses have been examined before the trial Court, and none of the witnesses has stated that present applicant has pressurized them to deposit money.
The applicant is an acting Director in the Company.
She is in custody since 03.12.2022.
Therefore, it has been prayed that applicant/accused be enlarged on bail.

sentences.text: Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State on the other hand submits that applicant has two criminal antecedents, therefore, he prays for dismissal of this application.
5. Considering the period of custody and all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for her regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that she shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

She shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-JBP:627 3 MCRC-35955-2025 480(3) of BNSS.
7. This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
